about: Make's tools for agents (through Agent Link): name, what it does, its arguments as JSON Schema, its group, whether it changes the document.

fit.description: Fits for made parts: action size { nominal, of: hole|shaft, kind: press|snug|slide|free (all when left out), body } gives the size to model at, the printer calibration added; calibrate { hole, shaft } keeps how much this printer prints a hole small and a peg big (diametral mm); stack { items: [{ name, nominal, tol }], target: [lo, hi] } adds a tolerance stack worst case and RSS.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

fit.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

hw_hole.description: A hole for hardware in a body, FreeCAD's own Hole where it can be: kind clearance, counterbore, countersink, nut_trap (screws M2 to M8, fit close|normal|loose), insert (heat-set, typical sizes), magnet (size "6x2"); at [x,y,z] where it enters, on a flat face; dir into the material (-z by default; +x … or [x,y,z]); depth mm or "through". In a PartDesign Body it is FreeCAD's own Hole (its ISO 273 clearance, counterbore and countersink), editable in its panel; with a printer allowance it is FreeCAD's plain hole (Profile None) at FreeCAD's size plus the allowance, so FreeCAD keeps it on recompute and reopen (allowanceOn says which properties carry it; the size is in its Label2); a nut trap adds a Pocket. The head side (screw head, counterbore, countersink, nut trap) is the face at enters by: headSide says which ("countersink on the face at x=0, facing -x") — for a wall-mount bracket enter from the face away from the wall. face: the entry face ("Face6") instead of finding it from at and dir; sketch: a sketch whose circles are the holes. In a plain Part solid it is cut as a shape (route says which). Answers the sizes used, the features made and whether the body is still sound.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

face.description: The entry face on the Body's tip, e.g. Face6 (PartDesign Body only).

sketch.description: A sketch in the Body whose circles are the holes' centres (PartDesign Body only; at not needed).

hw_hole.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

thread_lookup.description: Thread sizes from FreeCAD's own tables (PartDesign Hole's), mm: size (M6, M10x1.25, 1/4-20, #10-32) gives major, pitch, pitch diameter, internal and external minor, tap drill, and a heat-set insert's hole where Make has one; or a table by series (metric, metric-fine, unc, unf), near: a diameter for the six nearest. Every size FreeCAD's Hole lists; a size of your own in ~/.config/workshop_make/threads.json.
thread_lookup.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

thread_identify.description: What thread a hole or shaft is: a cylindrical face by query gives its diameter, hole or shaft, length, and the nearest standard sizes — a hole read as tap drill, internal minor or major, a shaft as major — each with how far off. When sizes tie but for pitch it says needs: pitch: ask the person or measure, then give pitch. scan: { axis, band, length } reads a scanned thread instead — pitch, starts, hand, flank and the standard it matches — where ScanRulerFC is installed (its scan_thread).

faces.description: The cylindrical face by query: { near: [x,y,z] } (cylindrical faces only) or { faces: ["Face7"] }

scan.description: As scan_thread takes: { axis: { element } | { origin, direction, radius }, band, length, pitchFloor }.

thread_identify.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

thread_cut.description: Thread a hole with FreeCAD's PartDesign Hole: size (or the nearest when it is plain), mode cosmetic (the hole drilled to the tapping size, the thread recorded — the default) or modelled (the thread cut into the part; slow on fine threads), depth mm (the hole's length), from [x,y,z] the end to start at (the open end by default). A shaft can be recorded cosmetic only. Refused when the hole is bigger than the thread.

faces.description: The cylindrical face by query: { near: [x,y,z] } (cylindrical faces only) or { faces: ["Face7"] }

thread_cut.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

hw_embed.description: Encase a bought part mid-print: cut a pocket for kind nut (size M2…M8), magnet ("6x2"), bearing (608, 625 … or "22x7"), insert (M2…M8), weight ("20x8" or "30x20x6"), box (dims [w,d,h]) or cylinder (dims [d,h]), standing upright, its floor's centre at [x,y,z], turn ° about z. Sized with the printer's fit calibration (fit slide by default) and a headroom of 0.2 mm; its top is rounded up to the body's print setup layer grid and the pause comes after that layer. Refused when the pocket would open the part or the roof over it is under 2 layers (minRoof raises it). Trap: needs a print setup; the part goes in from above, so nothing may overhang the pocket.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

hw_embed.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

hw_embed_list.description: The parts encased in a body: each pocket's size, floor and top from the bed, the layer it pauses after, its roof. Pockets an undo filled are dropped.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

hw_embed_list.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

hw_unembed.description: Take an encased part out by id: its pocket filled again, or keepPocket: true leaves it open as a hole (pressed in after printing) and drops only the pause.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

hw_unembed.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

hw_pauses.description: Every pause a body's print needs: layer numbers and heights from the bed, what goes in at each, two on one layer made one; gen_make's magnets included. The layer grid is the body's print setup's.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

hw_pauses.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

setup.description: How each part is made, recorded: action list (the setups and the kinds), of { body }, add { type: print|cut|mill, bodies, settings, name }, set { id, bodies | add | remove, settings (null drops one), name }, remove { id }. Print settings: printer (generic, bed-slinger, corexy, h2d), nozzle, layerHeight, firstLayer, walls, infill, topLayers, bottomLayers. A body in no setup has no process: ask, then add. Kept with the document.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

setup.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

part_spec.description: The limits every part must meet, kept with the document: spec { minWall mm, massMin g, massMax g } (null drops one; clear: true starts again), and what parts are made of: material (pla, petg, abs, asa, pa6-cf, tpu-95a; "" forgets theirs) for bodies (the one body when left out).
part_spec.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

dfm_check.description: Is a body printable as it stands (+z up), with its print setup's nozzle and printer: thin walls (under one line an error, under two lines a warning), overhangs past 50°, flat ceilings over 10 mm, upright holes too small to print open, bed contact, tall and thin, build volume. Findings F1 … with value, limit, where and what to do. waive { id, reason } accepts one of the last check's findings on purpose — kept, and it comes back waived.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

dfm_check.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

part_review.description: One verdict on a part, pass, fix or unknown, after every change: soundness, and how it is made decides the rest — in a print setup the printability check judges it; in no setup its findings come under ifPrinted, for information; the least wall and the mass (as printed in a print setup, encased magnets counted) against the spec kept with part_spec, or spec given here for this review alone. waive: [{ rule, at, reason }] accepts a place on purpose, kept.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

material.description: pla (default), petg, abs, asa, pa6-cf, tpu-95a

part_review.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

slice.description: Slice a body in a print setup with the slicer on this computer (PrusaSlicer's command line; AGENTLINK_SLICER names another binary): the setup's layers, nozzle, walls and infill, the part's material as the filament. Answers the G-code's path, print time, filament (g, mm) and layers; parts encased at a pause (magnets) get it written into the G-code before the first layer over them. Refused for a part in no print setup.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

slice.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

mass_calibrate.description: Calibrate mass to a weighed print: grams (what it weighed, anything encased in it included) for a body; every reading for its print setup (or, unprinted, its material) is then scaled to match — the printer, spool and settings as they really are. Kept with the document; reset: true goes back to the material's figures.
mass_calibrate.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

mass_properties.description: Each body's mass (g) in its material — as printed (walls and infill, an estimate) when it is in a print setup, else solid — its centre of mass (mm) and inertia about it (g·mm², principal moments too), with encased parts counted: gen_make's magnets and ballast cut by mass_ballast. A body with no material is taken as PLA and says so.
mass_properties.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

mass_target.description: How far a body is from a target mass (g) and/or centre of mass (com [x, y, z], null for an axis that does not matter): the differences, whether it is met (massTol g, comTol mm, 0.5 each), and what would meet it — the ballast's mass and where its centre must be, or the mass to take away.

com.description: [x, y, z] mm; null for an axis that does not matter

mass_target.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

mass_ballast.description: Lay out closed upright ballast pockets inside a body, minWall (the spec's, else 1.2 mm) clear of every surface, to reach a target mass and/or move the centre of mass (com, null for a free axis): fill steel-bb, lead, tungsten or a density g/cm³, packing (0.6 loose shot), diameter mm (8), maxPockets (12). Answers each pocket, the fill's mass, and the mass and centre before and after (as made: printed or solid). cut: true cuts them (one undo step) and counts the fill in mass_properties; the print needs a pause to fill them.

com.description: [x, y, z] mm; null for an axis that does not matter

mass_ballast.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 1f705f4 (moved to Workshop Make)

slicer_presets.description: The person's own slicer presets, as data: action list { slicer (bambustudio, orcaslicer), kind, query }; fetch { vendors } (OrcaSlicer, whose own system presets are packed: the same version's, as JSON, by git) the printer, process and filament presets on this computer (their own first) and the saved bundles; use { body, machine, process, filament | bundle } puts them on the body's print setup, which then takes its layer height, walls, infill and shells from them and slices with them; export { machine, process, filament | bundle | body, path, name } writes one flattened JSON bundle (and keeps it); import { path, name } keeps a bundle to use. Nothing of a printer is in the code.
slicer_presets.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 25bafcb (moved to Workshop Make)

slice_with.description: Slice a body in a print setup with slicer prusaslicer (default), orcaslicer or bambustudio, by its command line: profiles { machine, process, filament } JSON paths for OrcaSlicer and Bambu Studio (minimal ones written from the setup when left out), { config } an .ini for PrusaSlicer. Gives time, filament and layers, and writes in a pause after the layer over each encased part (hw_embed, gen_make magnets; M601, Bambu M400 U1, or pauseCommand). OrcaSlicer and Bambu Studio also take bodies (several on one plate, arranged), orient and arrange (the slicer's own), and project: true (the sliced plate as a .3mf its window opens). Trap: a slicer not on this computer is refused unavailable, naming those present (AGENTLINK_ORCASLICER, AGENTLINK_BAMBUSTUDIO set their paths).
slice_with.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 25bafcb (moved to Workshop Make)

slice_read.description: Read an OrcaSlicer or Bambu Studio project (.3mf) back — one Agent Link wrote, or one the person changed and saved in the slicer's window: the presets it names and each setting changed from them (project-wide and per filament), every object's own settings (and its modifier parts), the plates, the slicer's warnings, and when sliced its time, weight, cost and features. slice: true slices it as it stands first (its own settings, headless), with the same answer.
slice_read.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 25bafcb (moved to Workshop Make)

slice_open.description: Open a project (.3mf) in the slicer's own window for the person (OrcaSlicer by default, or bambustudio): they change what they like there and save, then slice_read brings it back. Window only.
slice_open.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 25bafcb (moved to Workshop Make)

printer_add.description: Keep a printer on the network by name: kind octoprint (key: its API key), moonraker or klipper (key only if it asks for one), prusalink (key, or user and password for its digest login); url its address. Kept in .agentlink-printers.json in the session's folder, the key never given back; it is tried at once (check: false skips that). Trap: Bambu Lab printers are refused — they need LAN mode with their own protocol, or Bambu Studio.
printer_add.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 25bafcb (moved to Workshop Make)

printer_list.description: The printers kept: name, kind, address and how it logs in (no keys). remove: a name forgets it.
printer_list.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 25bafcb (moved to Workshop Make)

printer_status.description: A printer's state now: idle, printing, paused …, nozzle and bed temperatures (now and target, °C), the job's file and progress (percent).

printer.description: The printer's name, as printer_add kept it; may be left out when there is one.

printer_status.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 25bafcb (moved to Workshop Make)

printer_send.description: Upload a G-code file (path, or a name in the session's folder) to a printer. It is not started unless start: true AND confirm: "start <printer name>" — starting a print is the person's call: ask them, never start one on your own. Refused while the printer has a job.

printer.description: The printer's name, as printer_add kept it; may be left out when there is one.

storage.description: Where on the printer: local (OctoPrint), gcodes (Moonraker), usb (PrusaLink) by default.

printer_send.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 25bafcb (moved to Workshop Make)

printer_pause.description: Pause the printer's job: confirm: "pause <printer name>" — the person's call.

printer.description: The printer's name, as printer_add kept it; may be left out when there is one.

printer_pause.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 25bafcb (moved to Workshop Make)

printer_stop.description: Stop (cancel) the printer's job — it cannot be resumed: confirm: "stop <printer name>" — the person's call.

printer.description: The printer's name, as printer_add kept it; may be left out when there is one.

printer_stop.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 25bafcb (moved to Workshop Make)

cut_check.description: Can a body in a cut setup be cut from sheet: two parallel flat faces a constant thickness apart and every other face square to them (faces that are not named); its thickness against the setup's sheet; holes, webs (material between cuts) and slots under the least feature for the machine (laser, waterjet, plasma, router), material and thickness; a router's inside corners tighter than its cutter; plasma holes under the thickness; sheet [w,h] fit. Verdict fix, pass with warnings or pass. Trap: the least features are rules of thumb, said under assumed with the kerf and material when the setup leaves them out.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

cut_check.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 5b1bbde (moved to Workshop Make)

cut_export.description: The flat profiles of one or more sheet bodies (bodies, copies n or { body: n }) laid out on the sheet [w,h] by FreeCAD's BIM Nest (no turns; the gap its margin) where BIM is here, else in rows (layout says which; nest: false for rows) (a gap between, 3 mm or two kerfs by default), as DXF (R12: LINE, ARC, CIRCLE, POLYLINE; layers OUTER and HOLES) and SVG in mm, read back and counted. compensate: true offsets each profile by half the kerf (outside out, holes in) — leave it off when the cutter's software does that. One thickness per file.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

nest.description: Lay the parts out with FreeCAD's BIM Nest when a sheet is given (true by default).

cut_export.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 5b1bbde (moved to Workshop Make)

mill_check.description: Can a body in a mill setup be milled: faces no tool direction reaches (undercuts, named), faces past the tool's reach, inside corners along a direction rounder than the least tool can make, holes and pockets past the reach or over 4 times as deep as wide, thin walls for the material, the stock. Directions from the setup's axes (3: +z only; 3+2: all six) unless given. Verdict fix, pass with warnings or pass. Trap: tool, reach, material and stock the setup leaves out are assumed and said so; a face on the stock's outside counts as the stock's.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

directions.description: Sides the tool comes from; by default the setup's axes: 3 is +z, 3+2 all six.

tool.description: The least end mill's diameter, mm (the setup's minTool).

reach.description: How deep the tool reaches, mm.

material.description: aluminium, aluminum, steel, stainless, brass, copper, titanium, plastic, pom, wood

stock.description: [x, y, z] mm, as the part stands.

mill_check.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 5b1bbde (moved to Workshop Make)

mill_export.description: STEP of a milled body (read back) and its setup sheet by FreeCAD's CAM: the CAM Job that holds the body is reused as it is, else a new Job is made with the stock and least tool used here (cam: false skips CAM), and CAM's own Sanity report is the setup sheet (HTML), with Make's mill check added (verdict, findings, least wall, what was assumed, the stock material where CAM names none). Without CAM, Make's own Markdown sheet, and camNote says why. Takes mill_check's inputs.

body.description: A body's name; may be left out when there is one.

directions.description: Sides the tool comes from; by default the setup's axes: 3 is +z, 3+2 all six.

tool.description: The least end mill's diameter, mm (the setup's minTool).

reach.description: How deep the tool reaches, mm.

material.description: aluminium, aluminum, steel, stainless, brass, copper, titanium, plastic, pom, wood

stock.description: [x, y, z] mm, as the part stands.

cam.description: Use FreeCAD's CAM for the Job and setup sheet (true by default).

mill_export.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 5b1bbde (moved to Workshop Make)

fea_frame.description: A frame of straight members by beam elements (CalculiX B32): members [{ name, from, to, section { kind rect (b, d) | circ (d) | pipe (d, t) | box (b, d, t) }, material }] or bodies [box-like BIM members: their centre lines and sizes]; supports [{ at a member's end (within tolerance mm: 1, or the largest section with bodies), kind pinned | fixed | roller }]; loads [{ member, w N/mm down (or [wx,wy,wz]) | kPa with width mm }, { at a joint, force [fx,fy,fz] N }], gravity (own weight). Answers each member's stress along it, von Mises and safety, its deflection (span over deflection; deflectionLimit 360 judges it) and each support's reaction. Beams, rafters, portal frames, trusses, shelving.
fea_frame.source: Agent Link for FreeCAD 5b1bbde (moved to Workshop Make)
